- tests/test_review_synthesise_smoke.py:_install_mock_codex function (the embedded bash script body: "exit \"${MOCK_CODEX_EXIT_CODE:-0}\"") | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The Python function accepts an exit_code parameter but never passes it into the generated mock script, which reads the exit code exclusively from the MOCK_CODEX_EXIT_CODE environment variable.
  WHY: Any future test that calls _install_mock_codex(mock_bin_dir, exit_code=1) without also setting MOCK_CODEX_EXIT_CODE will see the mock always exit 0 and may falsely pass.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:materialize_synthesised_behavioural_smoke_tests() — embedded Python block, final `if copied == 0 and rows:` conditional (tail of the heredoc) | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: When the restored manifest is valid but lists zero files, `rows = []` makes the condition false, so the else branch prints `Materialized synthesised behavioural smoke tests from ... (files=0).`
  WHY: The message reads as a successful materialization even though nothing was materialized and automated log parsing can misclassify the run.
